analogy.rationale: Histamine receptors are G-protein-coupled receptors with limited expression in most of these cell lines, so agonists should elicit little transcriptional change; the closest reference classes are other histamine-receptor ligands and, more weakly, other aminergic GPCR agonists that share downstream cAMP/Ca2+ signaling.
